relation.rationale: Difference is the use of a diacritic (aͤ) versus a plain letter (a) in the same word form.
The difference is between 'ſchenken' and 'ſchaͤnken', which is a variation in spelling (presence/absence of 'a' and umlaut) for the same word.
Difference in the use of the long s (ſ) versus the short s (s) in the pronoun 'ihn'.

The readings differ in the specific word used: 'dem' (dative article) versus 'diſem' (demonstrative pronoun). While both are dative masculine singular, they are distinct lexical items with different semantic functions (definite article vs. demonstrative).
Haußfriden (household peace) and Friden (peace) are different words with different meanings.
The readings differ between the relative pronoun 'der' and the conjunction/adverb 'da', which are distinct words with different grammatical functions.
The readings 'er' (he) and 'nur' (only) are different words with different meanings.
Difference in vowel representation (e vs aͤ) for the same word form.
Difference between 'w' and 'v' (or 'u') in the same word, a common graphic variation in early modern German.
Difference in the representation of the umlaut (ü vs u) in the same word.
